newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago NBD realigns into 3 segments.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago NBD realigns into 3 segments.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Corp said Wednesday it has realigned the responsibilities of its senior executives to manage the $107 billion asset financial services company on a business segment basis.
The company, which was formed by the November 1995 merger of First Chicago Corp and NBD Bancorp, will be structured with three business segments, each headed by a vice chairman.
The segments include regional banking; corporate banking and investments; and credit card, insurance products and operations, First Chicago NBD said in a statement.

Thomas Jeffs II will be in charge of retail banking, David Vitale will head corporate bnaking and investments, and Scott Marks Jr. will be responsible for credit card, insurance products and operations, First Chicago said.

"We are structuring our senior management team to lead the Corporation now that we have successfully completed our merger," said Istock. "Our goals are to serve our customers well, increase our operating efficiency, and grow our franchise prudently. I am confident we can do that."
